Voat is still relatively new, and it's core-idea is freedom of speech, where anyone can say what they want to say without being censored. But freedom of speech doesn't mean you can't criticize bad ideas, or call out fake news, or even ridicule opinions. You're free to do all of that. If you see someone linking to a biased post, feel free to explain why you believe it's biased. Give your own sources. If people see the logic in your comment, yours will be upvoted.

Right now, the "white racist supremacist" posters are the ones who are most vocal, because they feel this is where they feel safe expressing their opinions. People of opposing worldviews can post on Reddit and other similar sites. You, and people who agree with you, can change that. Content is 100% user-driven. Bring your friends, message the mods regarding biased sources, wait a little until the community grows, and don't be afraid to comment/post your own ideas.

With time, Voat's userbase will be more and more neutral, as more people with opposing ideas register. Until then, you can subscribe to subverses that agree with your POV, comment on what you think is wrong (and explain why!), or just avoid those subs for the time being.
